product.name: Monoprice USB-C to Dual 4K DisplayPort Adapter (Dual 4K@60Hz)
product.description: Monoprice™USB‑C® to Dual 4K DisplayPort® AdapterSupports two 4K@60Hz DisplayPort® displays, Thunderbolt™ 3, and DP Alt ModeUnclutter your computer desktop and make your work easier and more productive by adding up to two 4K@60Hz DisplayPort® displays using the Monoprice™ USB‑C® to Dual 4K DisplayPort Adapter. This plug 'n' play adapter requires no external drivers or special configuration. Just plug it in and adjust your desktop the way you want. It is compatible with USB Type‑C® or Thunderbolt™ 3 host systems running the Windows® and macOS® operating systems, with support for DisplayPort Alt mode.It supports the Multi‑Stream Transport (MST) feature on Windows systems, which allows each display to show content different from each other and from the main host screen. It also supports the Single‑Stream Transport (SST) and Mirror display modes for both Windows and macOS systems. The adapter is compact and lightweight, making it easy to pack in your laptop bag and reducing desktop or back‑of‑the‑PC clutter.Supports up to two 4K@60Hz displays on DP 1.4 Alt Mode hostsSupports up to two 4K@30Hz displays on DP 1.2 Alt Mode hostsCompatible with the Windows® and macOS® operating systemsSupport High‑Dynamic Range (HDR)Supports USB Type‑C® and Thunderbolt™ 3 hostsSupports Multi‑Stream Transport (MST) mode on Windows hostsSupports Single‑Stream Transport (SST) and Mirror display modes on both Windows and macOS hosts TWO 4K DISPLAYSThis USB‑C® to Dual 4K DisplayPort® Adapter supports two 4K@60Hz DisplayPort displays, when connected to hosts that support the DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode. For hosts that support DisplayPort 1.2 Alt Mode, the adapter supports two 4K@30Hz displays. WIDE COMPATIBILITYThis adapter is compatible with USB Type‑C® or Thunderbolt™ 3 hosts running both the Windows® and macOS® operating systems, with support for DisplayPort Alt mode. SUPPORTS MST, SST, AND MIRROR MODESThis USB‑C® to Dual 4K DisplayPort® Adapter supports the Multi‑Stream Transport feature on Windows® hosts, which allows each display to show content different from each other and from the main host screen. It also supports the Single‑Stream Transport (SST) and Mirror display modes for both Windows and macOS® systems. SST allows the external displays to show content different from the main screen, but identical to each other, while Mirror mode has the two external displays showing the same content as the main host screen. COMPACT AND LIGHTWEIGHTThe compact and lightweight adapter measures only 2.2" x 2.0" x 0.5", making it easy to pack in your laptop bag and reducing desktop or back‑of‑the‑PC clutter.Pick The Perfect USB‑C® Display Adapter That Fits Your Needs      P/N43526 43525 36656 13234 Video Outputs2x DisplayPort®2x HDMI®2x DisplayPort1x DisplayPortUSB Ports‑‑3x Type‑A, 1x Type‑C‑Data Transfer Rate‑‑3x 10Gbps, 1x 5Gbps‑USB Type‑A Power‑‑2x 1.5A/7.5W, 1x 900mA/4.5W‑USB Type‑C® Power‑‑60W Power Delivery‑Ethernet Ports‑‑1x Gigabit‑Card Slots‑‑1x SD™ 3.0, 1x microSD™ 3.0*‑Audio Support‑‑1x 3.5mm TRRS‑ *Both slots support UHS‑I speeds and can be used at the same time. .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
